name: MCP Toolbox for Databases
upstream_status_note: The repository was renamed from googleapis/genai-toolbox to googleapis/mcp-toolbox; the old address redirects. Quoted: “The `genai-toolbox` repository has been officially renamed to `mcp-toolbox`.”.
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C8, C10; partly meets C5; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The source repository is public and release v1.17.0 is published from it. The release notes list a SHA256 hash for each platform binary and link a signature file for the linux/amd64 binary.

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release v1.17.0 is dated 2026-11-13; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-14; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-14.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Prebuilt database tools are enabled by a flag and can be narrowed to a toolset; other tools are defined by the operator. No read-only switch is described in the README. Quoted: “You can also specify a specific toolset using the `--prebuilt=<database>/<toolset>` syntax”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Prebuilt configurations take connection settings from environment variables. (The README's `tools.yaml` example also shows a `password` field in the configuration file.) Quoted: “Set the appropriate environment variables to connect”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README describes OpenTelemetry export to an endpoint the operator sets with a flag; no collection by the publisher is described. Quoted: “Toolbox emits traces and metrics via OpenTelemetry. Use `--telemetry-otlp=<endpoint>`”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`go.sum`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial; `SECURITY.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: `go.mod` declares no MCP library; the server implements the protocol in its own source tree, which contains a module for specification revision 2026-07-28 (`internal/server/mcp/v20260728`), published within the last 12 months.
